definition_zh: 边缘；（悬崖等的）边沿；临界点
definition_en: the extreme edge of a steep place; the point just before something happens
core_image: 一个人单脚站在悬崖最边沿的一块碎石上，脚趾之外就是深渊
scene: 谈判进行了十一个小时，双方都在等待。By midnight the talks stood on the brink of collapse.
sceneCN: 这里 brink 是「临界点」（第 2 个义项：重大变化即将发生之际）；句意是到午夜时分，谈判已濒临破裂。

pos.zh: （重大事件的）临界点；边缘状态

derivatives.zh: 由复合词加名词后缀构成，义为「边缘政策；铤而走险外交」
由短语构成，义为「破产边缘」

senses.title: The edge of a steep place
senses.definition: the extreme edge of a cliff, roof, or other high place
senses.definitionCN: 悬崖、屋顶或其他高处的最外边沿
senses.example: She stood at the brink of the cliff, arms spread.
senses.exampleCN: 她站在悬崖边上，张开双臂。
senses.why: The Norse root meant the steep grassy edge itself, the land's last green inch.
senses.whyCN: 诺斯词根本指陡峭的草边——大地上最后一寸绿。

senses.title: The point before something happens
senses.definition: the moment or state just before a significant event, usually unwelcome
senses.definitionCN: 重大（多指不好的）事件即将发生前的时刻或状态
senses.example: The economy teetered on the brink of recession.
senses.exampleCN: 经济在衰退的边缘摇摇欲坠。
senses.why: The cliff's edge maps onto the edge of events: one step more and there is no return.
senses.whyCN: 悬崖之边映射为事态之边：再迈一步便无法回头。

senses.title: The edge of a liquid or container
senses.definition: the upper edge of a pool, well, or vessel
senses.example: The well was filled to its very brink.
senses.why: Water reaching its edge is the oldest concrete picture the word keeps.
senses.whyCN: 水涨至边沿是这个词保留的最古老具体画面。

senses.title: The edge of destruction
senses.definition: the point before ruin, death, or disaster
senses.definitionCN: 毁灭、死亡或灾难到来之前的一点
senses.example: Rescuers found him on the brink of death.
senses.exampleCN: 救援者发现他已奄奄一息。
senses.why: Since ruin is the deepest fall, it inherits the cliff's vocabulary.
senses.whyCN: 毁灭是最深的坠落，于是继承了悬崖的词汇。

senses.title: The edge of a new state
senses.definition: the point before a major positive change, as on the brink of stardom
senses.definitionCN: 重大（可指好的）变化之前的一点，如成名边缘
senses.example: The young band stood on the brink of stardom.
senses.exampleCN: 这支年轻乐队正站在成名的边缘。
senses.why: Not every fall is downward; an edge faces two directions at once.
senses.whyCN: 坠落未必向下；边缘总是同时面向两个方向。

senses.title: Brinkmanship in politics
senses.definition: the practice of pushing a dangerous situation to the edge to gain advantage
senses.definitionCN: 把危险局势推向边缘以谋利的策略
senses.exampleCN: 那场对峙是十足的边缘策略。
senses.why: The edge becomes a chess move when both players know the cliff is there.
senses.whyCN: 当双方都看得见悬崖，边缘便成了一步棋。

senses.title: The lip of exhaustion or capacity
senses.definition: the point just before exhaustion, tears, or breakdown
senses.definitionCN: 体力、情绪或精神崩溃之前的一点
senses.example: After three night shifts she was on the brink of tears.
senses.exampleCN: 连上三个夜班后，她已濒临崩溃落泪。
senses.why: Inner states borrow the outer cliff: feeling and body share the same geography.
senses.whyCN: 内心状态借用外部悬崖：情绪与身体共用同一张地图。

senses.title: A narrow margin in time
senses.definition: the last possible moment before a deadline or change
senses.definitionCN: 期限或变化前的最后一刻
senses.example: The deal was saved at the very brink of midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 协议在午夜前的最后一刻达成。
senses.why: Clocks make cliffs of us all: midnight is simply a brink in time.
senses.whyCN: 钟表让每个人都临渊而立：午夜不过是时间里的崖边。

intro.en: Brink came from Old Danish brink and Old Norse brykja, the steep grassy edge of land over water or a fall.
intro.cn: brink 源自古丹麦语 brink 与古诺斯语 brykja，指临水或临崖的陡草坡边。

items.en: A root *brenk- for bend or edge has been reconstructed; the exact shape is uncertain.
items.cn: 有学者重构词根 *brenk-（弯、边），具体形式尚不确定。

items.en: Old Danish brink named the steep green bank where fields fell toward water.
items.cn: 古丹麦语 brink 指田野陡然落向水边的青草陡岸。

items.en: Norse settlers carried brink into northern English dialects for steep banks.
items.cn: 十三世纪诺斯移民把 brink 带入英格兰北部方言，指陡岸。

items.en: For centuries brink stayed regional, marking a brae's lip or a well's edge.
items.cn: 数世纪间 brink 停留于地域用法，标记坡沿与井沿。

items.en: The figurative edge of events spread from the literal cliff in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 十六世纪，「事态边缘」的比喻义自字面悬崖扩散开来。

items.en: The Cold War coined brinkmanship, fixing brink at the center of strategic talk.
items.cn: 冷战造出 brinkmanship，使 brink 成为战略语言的核心词。

note.en: Brink's look-alikes ring with -nk; its near group is the family of edges.
note.cn: brink 的形近词多带 -nk 尾；近义组是各种「边缘」。

entries.definition: the art of pushing danger to the edge
the plural form, rare in use

entries.definitionCN: 眨眼；一词之差，词源不同
砖；只是拼写相近，词源不同
边缘；通用词，brink 特指陡处与险境

entries.definition: the point beyond which something begins
entries.definitionCN: 临界；与 on the brink of 互换频繁

entries.definition: the top edge of a container
a point of transition between states
entries.definitionCN: 转折点；多用于积极变化

entries.definition: a sheer cliff; a dangerous position
entries.definitionCN: 绝壁；险境，语义比 brink 更极端

normalIntro.en: Hear the nose of the word: brink stops abruptly, just like an edge.
normalIntro.cn: 听这个词的鼻音收尾：brink 戛然而止，正如边缘本身。

normal.cn: brink 源自诺斯语，非拉丁。

normal.en: the old sense was a grassy steep bank over water.
normal.cn: 古义指临水而陡的草岸。

normal.en: on the brink of war is the classic collocation.
normal.cn: on the brink of war 是经典搭配。

normal.en: brinkmanship = brink + man + ship, the Cold War coin.
normal.cn: brinkmanship 由 brink＋man＋ship 合成，系冷战新词。

normal.en: verge and cusp are its polite cousins.
normal.cn: verge 与 cusp 是其温和的表亲。

abstract.en: One loose pebble between standing and falling.
abstract.cn: 站稳与坠落之间，只隔一颗松动的碎石。

abstract.en: Every brink faces two ways: the drop, and the path back.
abstract.cn: 每道边缘都面向两头：深渊与归路。

abstract.en: News loves the brink: it is drama compressed to a point.
abstract.cn: 新闻热爱边缘：那是被压缩成一点的戏剧。

examples.en: The village perched on the brink of the gorge.
Diplomats pulled both nations back from the brink.
examples.cn: 外交官们把两个国家从战争边缘拉了回来。

examples.en: She peered over the brink and watched the river foam below.
examples.cn: 她俯身崖边，望着下方翻腾白沫的河水。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「蹦」——脚尖在崖边一「蹦」就掉下去：brink 就是那一脚之差的崖沿。

root: 古丹麦语 brink（陡草岸）／古诺斯语 brykja（同义），属日耳曼语系；重构词根 *brenk-（弯、边）存疑，十三世纪经诺斯移民进入英格兰北部方言。

sensesIntro.en: From the green lip of a Danish field, the word grew to the edge of wells, of events, of ruin, and of midnight.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从丹麦田野的青草崖沿，长到井沿、事态之沿、毁灭之沿，直到午夜的边沿。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a boot toe on the last inch of grass before the fall
core.cn: 核心意象：坠落之前，鞋尖还踩着最后一寸草

branches.en: the literal lip: cliffs and brimming wells
branches.cn: 字面之沿：悬崖与满溢的井沿

branches.en: the edge of time: events and midnight a step away
branches.cn: 时间之沿：一步之遥的事件与午夜

branches.en: the inner cliff: ruin, tears, breakdown
branches.cn: 内心之崖：毁灭、泪水、崩溃

branches.en: the edge as a game: stardom and brinkmanship
branches.cn: 边缘成棋局：星途与边缘策略

branches.en: the body's cliff: exhaustion and tears at the rim
branches.cn: 身体之崖：濒临崩溃与落泪的边沿

intro.en: A single Norse morpheme; the great derivative is the Cold War compound brinkmanship.
intro.cn: 单一诺斯语语素；最重要的派生词是冷战复合词 brinkmanship。

latinIntro.en: No Latin cognates; Latin limes and margo cover edges in their own way.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词；拉丁语以 limes、margo 各自表边。

items.exampleCN: margin 是 margo 的英语后代
blink 与 brink 仅押韵

latinEntries.example: margo paginae, the edge of a page
limes imperii, the border of empire
